title.narrative: Programa de Vivienda de Inters Social

description.narrative: Los objetivos del Programa son apoyar los esfuerzos del Gobierno de Honduras en efectar cambios de poltica y desarrollar mecanisms que aumentan la disponibilidad y asequibilidad de vivienda adecuada, particularmente para la majora de famiilias honureas que actualmente no la pueden obtener.

The program's objectives are to support the Government of Honduras' efforts adapt policy changes and to develop mechanisms that increase the availability and affordability of adequate housing, particularly for the majority of families currently unable to obtain such housing.
